statement: SELECT COUNT(*) AS region_count, SUM(registered_bev_passenger_car_stock) AS registered_bevs, SUM(registered_passenger_car_stock) AS registered_passenger_cars, SUM(in_service_registered_charging_facilities) AS in_service_facilities, SUM(in_service_registered_charging_points) AS in_service_points, SUM(in_service_registered_normal_charging_points) AS in_service_normal_points, SUM(in_service_registered_fast_charging_points) AS in_service_fast_points, CAST(SUM(in_service_registered_facility_nominal_power_kw) AS DECIMAL(20,3)) AS in_service_registered_facility_nominal_power_kw, CAST(AVG(bev_penetration_percent) AS DECIMAL(18,4)) AS mean_region_bev_penetration_percent, CAST(PERCENTILE(bev_penetration_percent, 0.5) AS DECIMAL(18,4)) AS median_region_bev_penetration_percent, CAST(AVG(in_service_registered_charging_points_per_1000_bevs) AS DECIMAL(18,4)) AS mean_region_points_per_1000_bevs, CAST(PERCENTILE(in_service_registered_charging_points_per_1000_bevs, 0.5) AS DECIMAL(18,4)) AS median_region_points_per_1000_bevs, CAST(AVG(in_service_registered_fast_charging_points_per_1000_bevs) AS DECIMAL(18,4)) AS mean_region_fast_points_per_1000_bevs, CAST(PERCENTILE(in_service_registered_fast_charging_points_per_1000_bevs, 0.5) AS DECIMAL(18,4)) AS median_region_fast_points_per_1000_bevs, CAST(AVG(in_service_registered_charging_facilities_per_1000_bevs) AS DECIMAL(18,4)) AS mean_region_facilities_per_1000_bevs, CAST(PERCENTILE(in_service_registered_charging_facilities_per_1000_bevs, 0.5) AS DECIMAL(18,4)) AS median_region_facilities_per_1000_bevs, CAST(AVG(in_service_registered_facility_nominal_power_kw_per_1000_bevs) AS DECIMAL(18,4)) AS mean_region_nominal_power_per_1000_bevs, CAST(PERCENTILE(in_service_registered_facility_nominal_power_kw_per_1000_bevs, 0.5) AS DECIMAL(18,4)) AS median_region_nominal_power_per_1000_bevs, MIN(kba_reference_date) AS kba_reference_date, MIN(bnetza_reference_date) AS bnetza_reference_date, MIN(destatis_reference_date) AS destatis_reference_date, MIN(kba_to_bnetza_lag_days) AS kba_to_bnetza_lag_days, MIN(date_set_id) AS date_set_id, MIN(publication_state) AS publication_state FROM __CATALOG__.gold.vw_powerbi_region_kpi_published WHERE date_set_id = '__DATE_SET_ID__'
